name: Mujahidul Islam Selim
contribution: Selim was a prominent organiser of Bangladesh’s organised left and a leading figure in the democratic movement against Hussain Muhammad Ershad.
context: He worked through left political alliances during the late-1980s anti-authoritarian mobilisation and the mass uprising of 1990.
impact: His political work helped keep left parties visible in the coalition that pressed for the restoration of parliamentary democracy.
